description_for_human: Free, OpenAI-compatible AI with post-quantum-signed proof-of-inference receipts. No API key.
description_for_model: Free, unauthenticated, OpenAI-compatible inference API funded by the Animica foundation treasury. Base URL https://animica.dev/v1. Use POST /v1/chat/completions with an OpenAI-style body. No API key or Authorization header is required. Recommended models: 'deepseek-coder:6.7b' for code, 'qwen2.5:7b' for general reasoning. Rate limit 30 requests/minute per IP; on HTTP 429 back off and retry. Every response includes a signed proof-of-inference receipt.
